name: dictate
description: Dictate: a clickable mic for Claude Code's built-in voice dictation. Click to start, click again to send, × to discard.

icon.title: Mic icon
icon.description: nerd: Nerd Font microphone (needs a Nerd Font in the terminal). emoji: the 🎤 emoji.

promptRows.title: Rows from the hint line up to the prompt row
promptRows.description: Where the mic is painted. 4 fits a two-line status line; change it if the mic lands on the wrong row.
